screen.speedhud.title: BetterSpeedHUD Settings
screen.speedhud.hint: 1 Overall 2 Gear 3 Digits 4 km/h 5 Bar | Drag/Arrows: move · Wheel or +/-: scale · V: master · C: real speed · F: font · [ ]: max speed · Esc: save
screen.speedhud.info: Adjusting: %s    Max speed: %d km/h    Position: X %d, Y %d, Size %.2fx
screen.speedhud.desc_real_speed: When real speed is off, the number stops increasing at max speed (pegged); when on, the real speed is always shown.
screen.speedhud.desc_max_speed: Max speed: the speed at which the bar is full. The bar fill equals speed / max speed.
screen.speedhud.author: Author: @WYH827    Buttons in the way? Click the hide button at the top right.
